claim: AI is inserted only at four high-cost bottlenecks and one technical core is reused across three spatial laboratories.

insertion_points.ai_role: replaceable model interface produces a LivingTaskGraph and missing-information list
service-solving agent proposes and explains options
insertion_points.non_ai_guardrail: CapacityTwin plus constraint solver checks hard limits

insertion_points.ai_role: equity, operations-safety and data-protection agents review in parallel
insertion_points.non_ai_guardrail: one bounded revision and a human responsibility gate

insertion_points.bottleneck: failure learning and repeated review cost
insertion_points.ai_role: receipt/replay agent preserves provenance and versions
insertion_points.non_ai_guardrail: standalone deterministic runner recomputes exact results

reuse: LivingTaskGraph, CapacityTwin, review protocol and replay are shared; a new scenario adds adapters and fixtures rather than duplicating the platform.
boundary: Synthetic technical leverage only; not financial ROI, field performance or an implementation-cost estimate.
